factual_pattern: livestock land parcel → byproduct pollution → river Repyevka → measured exceedances → fish mortality → land/water/fisheries oversight
risk: Paperwork for livestock byproducts cannot substitute verification of the physical pathway to water and fish habitat.
evidence_court_practice: Prosecutor 2026-08-20: around 900 fish died, water pollutants exceeded standards by tens of times; administrative cases initiated; fisheries authority received separate representation for lack of cause/damage assessment; outcomes not reported.
diagnostic_questions: Could drainage or rain/snow runoff carry material to the river?
Does documented byproduct handling match real storage, treatment and land use?
Was fisheries damage assessed separately from land/water impacts?
red_flag: Byproduct records exist but drainage route, receptor samples and fish mortality are absent from incident review.
mirlex_checks: byproduct/waste legal classification and material flows

impact.site: Livestock byproduct runoff and water audit

update_needed: Append to existing ID; do not assume rain runoff proven; no active legal rule.
